title: Story premise EDU061: The Cupboard Behind the Cupboard
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (home organization). Hook: How many things must move before this lid can leave? Takeaway/theme: Storage usefulness depends on retrieval effort as well as total capacity.
description: A cook wants to find a frequently used lid, but deep stacks hide it behind rarely used pieces. A cutaway separates visible access space from hidden storage and gives the lid a reachable, labeled slot.
